description: In monkey V1, the first response to line segments is the same on figure and background, and figure-ground modulation follows later. When a figure is not seen, the feedforward V1 response persists but the figure-ground modulation is absent (Supèr et al. 2001, as reported by Lamme).
limitations: Reported secondhand in Lamme 2020. The original study, from Lamme's group, is not read here.

sources.quote: When figures are not seen, feedforward V1 responses persist, but figure-ground modulation is selectively absent
